agreements.description: The agreements the rights come from.

board_majority.description: The right to appoint or remove directors holding a majority of the board's votes: a ground for being a registrable controller (FR-EQ-25).

board_seats.description: The directors the holder may appoint.

consents.description: The matters that need the holder's consent; any could amount to significant influence, so a person weighs them (FR-EQ-25).

items.description: A matter that needs the holder's consent, such as a reserved matter.

from.description: The day the agreements give the rights from.

holder_id.description: The holder: a contact marked shareholder or investor.

information.description: The information rights: what and when.
examples: Quarterly management accounts within 45 days; annual accounts within 120 days

pro_rata.description: A pro-rata right in later rounds.
